set.body: Introduce checked immutable ScalarField2D with typed axes, dimensions, row-major finite samples, and explicit construction errors. Add the concise continuous-fill scale surface and renderer-neutral heatmap lowering. Acceptance: analytic construction and scale laws on JVM+JS, colorbar guide coverage, and ggplot2 tile/raster visual-QA comparisons.
set.title: Graphics scalar field 1: continuous-fill heatmaps
